limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

roadmap--blocked-item-compact-dark.png.task: Read a selected work item's state and purpose without repeated heading space.
roadmap--blocked-item-compact-dark.png.observations: Title and blocked status are compact and readable, but the large suggested-change section precedes the actual blocker. At compact height the user cannot see the blocking reason in the opening view. Reorder current dependency/readiness information ahead of proposals.

roadmap--selected-item-compact-dark.png.task: Read a selected work item's state and purpose without repeated heading space.
roadmap--selected-item-compact-dark.png.observations: Title, state and purpose now appear together before the section selector. The selected dependency connection remains clear on desktop; the compact inspector overlays part of the canvas while retaining its back control. No overlap or clipping in the changed header.
